result_preview.description: This agent automates the end-to-end coordination of performance review cycles in SuccessFactors. It creates review assignments based on organizational hierarchy, sends automated reminders to managers and employees at key milestones, escalates overdue reviews, and generates cycle completion reports. It reduces manual coordination overhead and ensures timely execution of performance management processes across the enterprise.

result_preview.description: Tracks employee development checkpoints and orchestrates collaborative assessment workflows involving supervisors, peer evaluators, and people operations teams. Handles timeline management, priority escalations, and comment distribution to drive appraisal completion. Aggregates 360-degree input streams and merges evaluations enterprise-wide.

result_preview.description: Coordinates performance review cycles by orchestrating review scheduling, automating stakeholder notifications, and monitoring review completion status across Employee and WorkforcePerson populations.
